TWO WEBCLIENT SERVICES CONVERTED FROM A LITERAL-RETURNING start() TO A CLASS. 13 -> 11.

  currency        webclient/currency_service.js         literal -> instance
  service_worker  webclient/service_worker_service.js   literal -> instance

Both were closures whose state -- the fetch generation counter, the settlement
deferred -- was reachable only from inside start(), which is the shape this gate
exists to retire. The move is the same one the 20 -> 13 note describes, applied
to the two the webclient still owned.

Attribution is an isolated measurement, not arithmetic on the working tree. The
shared checkout currently carries another session's uncommitted ui/ and hotkeys/
work, and reading the gates there gives jsfunclen 84 against a floor of 83 -- an
offender, ui_service.js useActiveElement, that is not this change's. Measured in
a worktree detached at b374ca33c72 with only this change's files copied in:

  jsserviceshape     13 -> 11
  jsfunclen          83 -> 83     unchanged
  jsprivate         244 -> 244    unchanged
  jsvacuous          21 -> 21     unchanged
  eslint          23079 -> 23079  unchanged
